positions.name: IdOmissionSlugRequirement
positions.frame: what must the pipeline do when a memory arrives without an explicit id field?
positions.why: src-1 establishes the triggering condition — the memory was submitted with no explicit id — and src-2 states the required pipeline response to exactly that condition: derive a slug (via LLM id-gen or deterministic fallback) and commit successfully. The flat factual assertion and the directive read together as setup-and-requirement for one test scenario; the conviction gradient (claim vs. decision) marks the shift from observed state to imposed obligation rather than a break in the shared subject.
